leftoverIssues: The script's --apply mode dropped the title='删除' prop on the trash-2 rewrite in src/views/device-selection/index.jsx. I restored it manually for consistency with sibling file-text (title='查看') and pencil (title='编辑') icons in the same renderActions column. Per Icon.md §3, title should be preserved as a native HTML attribute on icon+ components — the script's drop appears to be a script quirk, not the intended convention.

pencil → IconPlusIcIctBulkEdit is a best-effort match: the icon-plus catalog has no plain Edit/Pencil icon in any domain (Public/Ict/DigitalPowerDp/Bpit/HuaweiCloud). Available Edit-themed names are all compound/specialized (BulkEdit, TopoEdit, CollapseAllEdit, ExpandAllEdit, EditMesh, EditOutdoorDrawings). BulkEdit was chosen as the closest semantic match for an 'edit' action. If a more literal pencil icon is desired, consider contributing one to the icon-plus catalog or fall back to the IconPlusIcPublicTransverseRectangleTemplate placeholder.

bell → IconPlusIcPublicBellClock includes a 'Clock' element (the only bell-themed icon in the catalog). Visually this differs from a plain notification bell. Acceptable for a notification/alerts button (topnav 'title=告警') since the clock conveys 'recent alerts', but if a pure bell is required, no catalog option exists.
